tally.title: Against Tally
tally.body: A line counts as found when Tally has a voucher of the same amount within a few days. The comparison runs once this company's Tally books are imported; differences go to the Bug fixer.

book.title: In the book itself
book.reversed_one: {{count}} entry in these dates was reversed.
book.reversed_other: {{count}} entries in these dates were reversed.
book.note: Posted entries are never edited. A mistake is reversed and posted again, both linked, so the box always matches the book.

changes.title: What the ERP changes
changes.phone: The cash holder enters each line on the phone, picking an account or a party. No more typing it again into Tally.
changes.staff: Pay, advances and allowances go to the staff record and the payslip, so advances are recovered.
changes.contra: Paying cash into the bank is a contra entry, matched with the bank statement.
changes.close: Every line carries its running balance; the day's closing is the next day's opening.
changes.withoutGst: Receipts against bills without GST are marked, and only Admin and the CA see them.
